purpose: Test strategy families with published empirical support on target-venue MEXC data without modifying discovery-v1, regime-research-v1, or the frozen ENA candidate.

sources.citation: He, Manela, Ross, von Wachter, Fundamentals of Perpetual Futures
sources.evidence: paper reports high Sharpe ratios for futures-spot convergence strategies even under high trading costs

sources.citation: Karassavidis, Quantitative Evaluation of Volatility-Adaptive Trend-Following Models in Cryptocurrency Markets
sources.evidence: multi-horizon moving averages, RSI confirmation and ATR risk scaling produced positive historical risk-adjusted results on BTC/ETH
reported out-of-sample Sharpe 2.41 across 150+ crypto pairs over 2022-2024 with transaction-cost and regime robustness tests

sources.citation: Han, Kang, Ryu, Momentum in the Cryptocurrency Market: A Comprehensive Analysis under Realistic Assumptions
sources.evidence: strong evidence of time-series momentum but warns that many apparently profitable portfolios fail under liquidation and realistic-profitability tests

sources.citation: Technical analysis in cryptocurrency markets: Do transaction costs and bubbles matter?
sources.evidence: moving-average and breakout rules showed periods of profitability beyond buy-and-hold after transaction costs

dependence_and_trials.trial_unit: family x interval x parameter variant x round-trip cost case; 120-day calendar time fold is the dependence cluster and symbols are aggregated inside each fold

economics.notes: Price-family tests use the same conservative MEXC API futures cost cases as price-strategy-tournament-v1.1. Basis-convergence uses a separate two-leg friction stress grid.

donchian_breakout.market_state_hypothesis: large-range breakouts identify persistent directional states on slower horizons

ema_tsmom.external_prior: time-series momentum and volatility-adaptive trend-following literature
ema_tsmom.market_state_hypothesis: EMA separation normalized by ATR identifies persistent trend states

vol_scaled_momentum.market_state_hypothesis: past return scaled by realized volatility identifies directional persistence while suppressing weak noisy moves

basis_convergence.causality: basis is observed on a completed 1h bar; entry and exit execute at the next 1h open; realized funding is credited only while the short perpetual leg was already open across settlement
basis_convergence.two_leg_cost_note: 20/30/40 bps are all-in round-trip stress assumptions for both legs combined and are intentionally not presented as a guaranteed user fee tier
